title: Redis Persistence Wars: RDB, AOF, and Hybrid
description: Master Redis persistence: RDB, AOF, and Hybrid. Learn fork() copy-on-write, AOF rewrite mechanics, fsync policies, and prevent data loss.
linkedinHook: Most Redis engineers underestimate the true cost of an RDB snapshot or an aggressive AOF fsync. Your 'durable' setup might be leaking critical data or introducing hidden latency bombs.
linkedinBody: I just dropped a post diving deep into Redis's persistence strategies: RDB, AOF, and the new Hybrid approach. We look at the fork() copy-on-write mechanics, AOF rewrite magic, and how your fsync choices directly impact data loss windows and recovery times. It's a must-read if you run Redis in production.
